dispositions.sections: Manifest conformance: vetting requirements; submit: Meeting it; VTI-CMP-070–074
dispositions.local_proposition: Credential and vetting evidence can satisfy their individual checks.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Admission evidence independently corroborates eligibility.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires multiple items actually weighted as independent, common material controller/dependency and an independence-sensitive decision; none is established by the task contracts alone.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system aggregates separately presented evidence without evaluating whether the evidence sources are materially independent.
falsification: The system returns PASS because it counts materially dependent evidence as independent corroboration.
The system cannot establish source independence but treats separate presentation as proof of independence.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns admission decision; applicable governance framework may constrain policy; live authority cannot be conferred by policy alone.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: If a policy requires independence, trace vetter/issuer control and refuse or defer unsupported independent corroboration.
dispositions.potential_impact: Applicant and community; wrongful admission or exclusion.
dispositions.comparison: added-value: compare evidence dependencies across admission rather than count documents; submit itself already addresses criterion satisfaction.

dispositions.local_proposition: Removal response and authenticated receipt may both originate from community.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Two independent confirmations establish departure.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires reliance that counts the response and receipt independently despite shared material control; mere common issuance is not failure.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system aggregates separately presented evidence without evaluating whether the evidence sources are materially independent.
falsification: The system returns PASS because it counts materially dependent evidence as independent corroboration.
The system cannot establish source independence but treats separate presentation as proof of independence.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns lifecycle decision; member initiates own departure; administrator requires applicable community authority and policy controls.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Do not count the two assertions as independent; obtain independent observations if policy requires them.
dispositions.potential_impact: Departing member; false assurance of erasure or access removal.
dispositions.comparison: added-value: compare common provenance across records; a single receipt inspection cannot establish the second source relationship.

dispositions.sections: Decision Conformance/Security; List scoped reads; VTI-CMP-070–074
dispositions.local_proposition: Recorded grant and bridge cache can reproduce same VTA decision.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Independent attestations establish operator choice.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires two evidence items counted independently, shared origin and additional decision weight. Cache and grant alone do not imply that claim.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system aggregates separately presented evidence without evaluating whether the evidence sources are materially independent.
falsification: The system returns PASS because it counts materially dependent evidence as independent corroboration.
The system cannot establish source independence but treats separate presentation as proof of independence.
dispositions.authority: VTA owns authoritative grant and approver resolution; bridge enforces delivery; context admin sets binding; approver decides within authority.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Preserve common provenance and obtain genuinely independent evidence if required.
dispositions.potential_impact: Operator and conversation participants; false confidence in consent.
dispositions.comparison: limited: provenance weakness is already visible in decision contract; comparison makes duplication explicit.

dispositions.sections: Manifest items 5–6; Submit Which criterion governs
dispositions.local_proposition: Applicable criterion version determined by digest and grace.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Admission justified despite unresolved conflict of competent sources.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: No pair of current conflicting competent sources without precedence is established; old/new criteria have a specified rule.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system evaluates the proposition while authoritative conflict remains unresolved.
falsification: The system returns PASS by selecting a supportive authoritative source while silently ignoring an unresolved conflicting authoritative source.
The system interprets absence of a conflict-resolution rule as permission to choose whichever authoritative source produces PASS.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns admission decision; applicable governance framework may constrain policy; live authority cannot be conferred by policy alone.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Apply criterion version rule; if a separate unresolved competent conflict actually exists, do not PASS on selective evidence.
dispositions.potential_impact: Applicant and community; unjustified decision.
dispositions.comparison: no-added-value: version selection already handled locally; distinct unresolved conflict would need additional facts.

dispositions.local_proposition: Community reports departure; downstream may hold an older observation.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Departure status established despite unresolved current authoritative disagreement.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Cache divergence or differently timed assertions are not two current authoritative sources; no unresolved precedence established.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system evaluates the proposition while authoritative conflict remains unresolved.
falsification: The system returns PASS by selecting a supportive authoritative source while silently ignoring an unresolved conflicting authoritative source.
The system interprets absence of a conflict-resolution rule as permission to choose whichever authoritative source produces PASS.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns lifecycle decision; member initiates own departure; administrator requires applicable community authority and policy controls.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Reconcile timestamps and authoritative scope; refuse/defer only if genuine unresolved conflict remains.
dispositions.potential_impact: Member and verifier; incorrect access decision.
dispositions.comparison: no-added-value: distinguish stale state from authoritative conflict.

dispositions.local_proposition: VTA is authoritative; cache advisory.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Cache and VTA are equally authoritative conflicting sources.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Source specifies precedence for explicit point check/stale token; no second competent current authority established.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system evaluates the proposition while authoritative conflict remains unresolved.
falsification: The system returns PASS by selecting a supportive authoritative source while silently ignoring an unresolved conflicting authoritative source.
The system interprets absence of a conflict-resolution rule as permission to choose whichever authoritative source produces PASS.
dispositions.authority: VTA owns authoritative grant and approver resolution; bridge enforces delivery; context admin sets binding; approver decides within authority.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Defer to VTA when required, fail closed on ambiguous revoke.
dispositions.potential_impact: Conversation participants; unauthorized delivery.
dispositions.comparison: no-added-value: existing consent cache semantics already establish source precedence.

dispositions.local_proposition: Community recognizes an issuer for a particular criterion; issuer may attest a subject.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Community recognition automatically extends to an issuer-recognized third party for another scope.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires actual A→B and B→C recognition, absent competent transitivity rule and reliance on inferred A→C; ordinary credential acceptance is not itself transitivity.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system treats A-to-B and B-to-C relationships as sufficient authority for an A-to-C trust conclusion.
falsification: The system returns PASS for an A-to-C trust conclusion solely because A recognises B and B recognises C without an applicable transitivity rule.
The system treats an undeclared transitivity policy as permissive rather than unresolved or prohibited.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns admission decision; applicable governance framework may constrain policy; live authority cannot be conferred by policy alone.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Check exact issuer scope and explicit recognition rule; no automatic extension.
dispositions.potential_impact: Applicant/community; unauthorized admission or privileges.
dispositions.comparison: limited: issuer recognition is already local; ceremony trace exposes cross-scope reliance if present.

dispositions.local_proposition: Community authorizes a bounded administrator to remove a member.
dispositions.relying_proposition: External party recognized by that administrator may also exercise removal or derivative authority.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires concrete A→B and B→C recognition, no competent transitivity rule and relying acceptance; no such chain established by removal task.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system treats A-to-B and B-to-C relationships as sufficient authority for an A-to-C trust conclusion.
falsification: The system returns PASS for an A-to-C trust conclusion solely because A recognises B and B recognises C without an applicable transitivity rule.
The system treats an undeclared transitivity policy as permissive rather than unresolved or prohibited.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns lifecycle decision; member initiates own departure; administrator requires applicable community authority and policy controls.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Verify explicit delegation and current scope rather than infer from recognition.
dispositions.potential_impact: Member and third party; unauthorized removal or retained access.
dispositions.comparison: added-value conditional on actual cross-relationship chain; not an observed feature.

dispositions.local_proposition: Context admin binds approver; enrolled bridge may attest operator choice.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Approver or bridge recognition extends to another party for consent.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires actual chained recognition and no competent extension rule; bridge enrollment alone does not establish a second recognition edge.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system treats A-to-B and B-to-C relationships as sufficient authority for an A-to-C trust conclusion.
falsification: The system returns PASS for an A-to-C trust conclusion solely because A recognises B and B recognises C without an applicable transitivity rule.
The system treats an undeclared transitivity policy as permissive rather than unresolved or prohibited.
dispositions.authority: VTA owns authoritative grant and approver resolution; bridge enforces delivery; context admin sets binding; approver decides within authority.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Require VTA-authorized exact issuer/context and explicit delegation where needed.
dispositions.potential_impact: Operator and conversation participants; unauthorized disclosure.
dispositions.comparison: limited: local issuer checks already forbid unsupported authority; chain trace can explain inference.

dispositions.local_proposition: Community makes admission decision; exchange communicates it.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Integration may treat exchange coordinator as competent owner of admission.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires actual ambiguity or unstated ownership in deployment seam and absent reconciliation; selected upstream VTI assigns community ownership.
dispositions.trigger: The composed system selects, synthesizes, or infers a value for the material fact and returns a relying result as though semantic ownership were established.
falsification: The system returns PASS after choosing between overlapping semantic claims without an explicit competent owner or reconciliation rule.
A component is treated as owner of a material fact solely because it produced the most convenient or most recent value.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns admission decision; applicable governance framework may constrain policy; live authority cannot be conferred by policy alone.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Identify competent decision source; refuse/defer if deployment ownership is unresolved.
dispositions.potential_impact: Applicant and community; erroneous membership activation.
dispositions.comparison: limited: upstream ownership explicit; additional value is locating nonconforming deployment seam, not finding spec ambiguity.

dispositions.local_proposition: Removal response and receipt assert community-side effects; downstream observes access.
dispositions.relying_proposition: A convenient component owns effective downstream termination.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires material fact across components, unresolved ownership/reconciliation and PASS based on inferred owner. Source timing tension alone does not prove ownership ambiguity.
dispositions.trigger: The composed system selects, synthesizes, or infers a value for the material fact and returns a relying result as though semantic ownership were established.
falsification: The system returns PASS after choosing between overlapping semantic claims without an explicit competent owner or reconciliation rule.
A component is treated as owner of a material fact solely because it produced the most convenient or most recent value.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns lifecycle decision; member initiates own departure; administrator requires applicable community authority and policy controls.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Identify owner of membership state and each enforcement fact; withhold stronger completion claim if unresolved.
dispositions.potential_impact: Departing member and relying service; persistent access or misleading removal assurance.
dispositions.comparison: added-value: distinguishes multiple effect owners from request/receipt semantics.

dispositions.local_proposition: VTA owns grant; bridge enforces it.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Grant authority or delivery evidence owner is ambiguous.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: The selected contracts identify grant owner and enforcement role; no unresolved ownership of the material fact is established. Delivery observation is separate.
dispositions.trigger: The composed system selects, synthesizes, or infers a value for the material fact and returns a relying result as though semantic ownership were established.
falsification: The system returns PASS after choosing between overlapping semantic claims without an explicit competent owner or reconciliation rule.
A component is treated as owner of a material fact solely because it produced the most convenient or most recent value.
dispositions.authority: VTA owns authoritative grant and approver resolution; bridge enforces delivery; context admin sets binding; approver decides within authority.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Use VTA for grant and bridge observation for actual delivery; unresolved integration ownership requires separate evidence.
dispositions.potential_impact: Operator/participants; misleading consent assurance.
dispositions.comparison: no-added-value for grant ownership; already explicit locally.

dispositions.sections: Submit Meeting it; Admit Conformance item 7; VTI-APV-017
dispositions.local_proposition: Earlier VP check or parked direct-admission authorization valid at evaluation.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Later admission or access remains authorized on earlier evidence.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires later material decision, possible intervening change and no established continuity. For direct referral recheck is explicitly required; violating it is nonconforming.
dispositions.trigger: The later component reuses the earlier lifecycle result and returns PASS without obtaining current-enough evidence for the later material boundary.
falsification: The system returns PASS at execution using only an earlier lifecycle check when intervening state change is possible and continuity is unproved.
A stale earlier-stage status result is treated as equivalent to a later-stage current-state evaluation.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns admission decision; applicable governance framework may constrain policy; live authority cannot be conferred by policy alone.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Re-evaluate applicable status/authority at later execution; defer or refuse unsupported continuity.
dispositions.potential_impact: Applicant/community; unauthorized admission or access.
dispositions.comparison: added-value: locates later reliance across stages; recheck rule itself already local.

dispositions.local_proposition: Earlier membership/access check may have been valid.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Later access remains permissible after departure.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires earlier valid lifecycle observation, later material reliance, possible changed status and no positive freshness continuity.
dispositions.trigger: The later component reuses the earlier lifecycle result and returns PASS without obtaining current-enough evidence for the later material boundary.
falsification: The system returns PASS at execution using only an earlier lifecycle check when intervening state change is possible and continuity is unproved.
A stale earlier-stage status result is treated as equivalent to a later-stage current-state evaluation.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns lifecycle decision; member initiates own departure; administrator requires applicable community authority and policy controls.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Check current membership-derived authority and status; preserve unrelated grants.
dispositions.potential_impact: Former member and service; unauthorized access or unjustified exclusion.
dispositions.comparison: added-value: admission-to-departure trace makes time and dependency explicit.

dispositions.sections: List Retention; Revoke Security & Privacy; VTI-CMP-040–042
dispositions.local_proposition: Earlier cached allow valid when obtained.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Later release authorized after grant may change.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires later release, possible expiry/revoke, no current-enough continuity evidence and PASS using earlier check.
dispositions.trigger: The later component reuses the earlier lifecycle result and returns PASS without obtaining current-enough evidence for the later material boundary.
falsification: The system returns PASS at execution using only an earlier lifecycle check when intervening state change is possible and continuity is unproved.
A stale earlier-stage status result is treated as equivalent to a later-stage current-state evaluation.
dispositions.authority: VTA owns authoritative grant and approver resolution; bridge enforces delivery; context admin sets binding; approver decides within authority.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Honor expiry/revoke; defer to VTA as required; default-deny on ambiguity.
dispositions.potential_impact: Conversation participants; unauthorized content delivery.
dispositions.comparison: no-added-value for core stale-cache mechanism already established in #135; ceremony trace contextualizes it.

dispositions.sections: Submit Deciding; VTI-MEM-011; Receipt verifier rules 5–11
dispositions.local_proposition: Request identifier and signed ceremony membership bind documents.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Binding proves successful admission.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires valid artifact binding, separate effect proposition and absent/unresolved admission evidence; PASS solely on binding.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system interprets the valid binding as proof of execution or effect and returns PASS for completion or success.
falsification: The system returns PASS for successful execution solely because a valid context binding exists.
The system cannot produce execution or effect evidence but represents the binding itself as completion evidence.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns admission decision; applicable governance framework may constrain policy; live authority cannot be conferred by policy alone.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Require competent admission decision and applicable evidence; refer is not admit.
dispositions.potential_impact: Applicant/community; false membership activation.
dispositions.comparison: added-value: distinguish enactment membership and legitimate admission; source already expressly forbids exchange-success inference.

dispositions.local_proposition: Authenticated acknowledgment correlates to departure receipt.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Correlation proves removal and dependent status effects.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires valid binding with separate effect claim and absent/conflicting effect evidence; signed community removal assertion is not merely binding and must be assessed separately.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system interprets the valid binding as proof of execution or effect and returns PASS for completion or success.
falsification: The system returns PASS for successful execution solely because a valid context binding exists.
The system cannot produce execution or effect evidence but represents the binding itself as completion evidence.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns lifecycle decision; member initiates own departure; administrator requires applicable community authority and policy controls.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Check competent removal/status evidence and relevant enforcement; no effect PASS from correlation.
dispositions.potential_impact: Departing member; misleading erasure or access assurance.
dispositions.comparison: added-value: separates receipt delivery and downstream effects.

dispositions.local_proposition: Challenge and subject correlate request/decision; accepted means prompt routed.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Correlation establishes allow or delivery.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires valid binding, separate effect and absent effect evidence; actual recorded deny contradicts allow.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system interprets the valid binding as proof of execution or effect and returns PASS for completion or success.
falsification: The system returns PASS for successful execution solely because a valid context binding exists.
The system cannot produce execution or effect evidence but represents the binding itself as completion evidence.
dispositions.authority: VTA owns authoritative grant and approver resolution; bridge enforces delivery; context admin sets binding; approver decides within authority.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Require actual current allow and relevant delivery evidence; hold/drop otherwise.
dispositions.potential_impact: Operator/participants; unauthorized delivery.
dispositions.comparison: no-added-value for prompt/decision separation already in #135.

dispositions.local_proposition: Local proof, presentation and review exchanges can validate for their respective propositions.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Composed admission and current access are valid.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires at least two independently valid local propositions and an unevaluated additional seam obligation, e.g. actual access authorization; missing mandatory review means execution violation, not all tasks conforming.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system derives composition PASS directly from the component PASS results without evaluating the material seam obligation.
falsification: The system computes Composition(A,B)=PASS solely because A=PASS and B=PASS while an additional seam obligation is unevaluated.
A local conformance result is represented as composition assurance without evidence for the composed proposition.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns admission decision; applicable governance framework may constrain policy; live authority cannot be conferred by policy alone.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Evaluate applicable admission path and access authority separately; do not require review on automatic path.
dispositions.potential_impact: Applicant/community; wrongful access or denial.
dispositions.comparison: added-value: identifies composed proposition and distinguishes local correctness from path completion.

dispositions.local_proposition: Community-side departure and authenticated receipt delivery can be valid.
dispositions.relying_proposition: All membership-dependent enforcement and disclosure obligations are satisfied.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires two local validations, additional downstream obligation and absent evaluation; if source explicitly requires effect and it was not performed, classify nonconforming enforcement.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system derives composition PASS directly from the component PASS results without evaluating the material seam obligation.
falsification: The system computes Composition(A,B)=PASS solely because A=PASS and B=PASS while an additional seam obligation is unevaluated.
A local conformance result is represented as composition assurance without evidence for the composed proposition.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns lifecycle decision; member initiates own departure; administrator requires applicable community authority and policy controls.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Check dependent status/access/publication effects; distinguish pending lawful convergence from false completion.
dispositions.potential_impact: Member and service; continuing access or disclosure.
dispositions.comparison: added-value: makes dependent effects explicit without assuming atomicity.

dispositions.sections: Decision Conformance; List scoped reads; VTI-CMP-060–064
dispositions.local_proposition: Binding, decision and sync can each satisfy local contracts.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Whole interaction preserves privacy and legitimate purpose for every disclosed party.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires at least two local validations, additional actual composition privacy/purpose obligation and missing seam evaluation; no universal participant-consent requirement asserted.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system derives composition PASS directly from the component PASS results without evaluating the material seam obligation.
falsification: The system computes Composition(A,B)=PASS solely because A=PASS and B=PASS while an additional seam obligation is unevaluated.
A local conformance result is represented as composition assurance without evidence for the composed proposition.
dispositions.authority: VTA owns authoritative grant and approver resolution; bridge enforces delivery; context admin sets binding; approver decides within authority.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Evaluate applicable purpose and joint disclosure against policy; do not claim composition assurance solely from local PASS.
dispositions.potential_impact: Conversation participants; excessive disclosure or correlation.
dispositions.comparison: added-value conditional on additional deployment privacy obligation; not duplicate of stale cache finding.

dispositions.sections: Manifest vetting; Admit item 7; VTI-CMP-070–074; VTI-APV-007
dispositions.local_proposition: Threshold of nominal vetters or eligible referral approvers may be met.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Threshold establishes independent approval.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires actual numeric threshold, policy requiring material independence and missing/common-control evidence; distinct identifiers alone insufficient; not every criterion requires independence.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system converts threshold satisfaction into PASS for independent approval without establishing the required independence.
falsification: The system returns PASS for independent approval solely because the numeric threshold was met while independence is unresolved.
Multiple approvals controlled by the same material authority are counted as independent without an explicit rule permitting that interpretation.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns admission decision; applicable governance framework may constrain policy; live authority cannot be conferred by policy alone.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Check policy and material independence where required; otherwise do not invent additional rule.
dispositions.potential_impact: Applicant/community; captured admission or false rejection.
dispositions.comparison: added-value: distinguish criterion count from independent corroboration across actors.

dispositions.local_proposition: Policy may require confirmation for admin removal.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Numeric approval proves independent authorization.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires deployment with actual threshold, independence-sensitive policy and unresolved common control; task does not mandate universal quorum.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system converts threshold satisfaction into PASS for independent approval without establishing the required independence.
falsification: The system returns PASS for independent approval solely because the numeric threshold was met while independence is unresolved.
Multiple approvals controlled by the same material authority are counted as independent without an explicit rule permitting that interpretation.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns lifecycle decision; member initiates own departure; administrator requires applicable community authority and policy controls.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Check applicable rule and eligible independent approvers if required; respect bounded single-admin alternative.
dispositions.potential_impact: Member and community; captured removal or unjustified lockout.
dispositions.comparison: limited: conditional policy not demonstrated; composition exposes actor dependence.

dispositions.local_proposition: Selected flow resolves an authorized approver.
dispositions.relying_proposition: N-of-M independent approval is satisfied.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: No numeric quorum or independence-sensitive threshold in selected consent flow; generic VTI operation approval cannot be imported.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system converts threshold satisfaction into PASS for independent approval without establishing the required independence.
falsification: The system returns PASS for independent approval solely because the numeric threshold was met while independence is unresolved.
Multiple approvals controlled by the same material authority are counted as independent without an explicit rule permitting that interpretation.
dispositions.authority: VTA owns authoritative grant and approver resolution; bridge enforces delivery; context admin sets binding; approver decides within authority.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Do not require quorum unless a separately sourced deployment policy establishes it.
dispositions.potential_impact: Operator/participants; unjustified denial if nonexistent threshold imposed.
dispositions.comparison: no-added-value: outside selected profile; distinguish task-consent from message consent.

limitations: Documentary conditional hypotheses, not observed failures.
Each cell is one profile/case judgment; multiple variants do not increase denominator.
Case-specific precondition analysis is provisional pending adversarial review and final matrix validation.
VTI snapshot is separately pinned comparative evidence, not established cross-version conformance.
